root_of_trust.requirement: The first security-relevant bytes must arrive from an already-running trusted platform object or inherited exact-object fd. A pasted shell payload, pathname verify-then-reopen sequence, or verifier that first establishes its own executable trust is forbidden.

required_inherited_objects.entry_fd: already-open exact entry bytes; same-object read/eval only
required_inherited_objects.python_fd: already-open Python executable object whose loader/runtime closure is externally attested
required_inherited_objects.attestation_fd: sealed immutable exact-byte attestation created outside the Python payload

python_actual_use.executable: same opened object via inherited fd
python_actual_use.elf_loader: Class B/C externally attested and session-UID immutable for entire use interval
python_actual_use.transitive_libraries: complete exact inventory; each Class B/C or fd-bound equivalent
python_actual_use.stdlib: exact manifest plus Class B/C immutable roots or once-open exact-byte importer
python_actual_use.lib_dynload: exact native-extension inventory; Class B/C or sealed-fd loading
python_actual_use.startup_imports: all filesystem bytes reachable before custom verifier included in the external attestation

ambient_environment.policy: env-i allowlist from the outermost trusted entry onward

pre_oauth_matrix.rule: No row may be printed PASS unless its evidence has actually been mechanically proven. BLOCKED/PARTIAL are terminal rc92 before OAuth.

receipts.pre_python: must be emitted by the trusted outer entry before any Python invocation using exclusive non-following creation semantics or an equivalent fd-bound mechanism
receipts.runtime: stage-specific denial receipt plus exact rc
